subject: Convergence: architecture deep-dive — reconfirming timing and agenda

Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Aug 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Convergence: architecture deep-dive — proposed slots

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the productive discovery session last week. The team had a few follow-ups and we'd like to schedule a 60–75 minute technical deep-dive to walk through:

- Your current inference topology and traffic patterns
- Where Redwood could replace/augment components (routing, KV-cache, batching)
- A short ops playbook and integration checklist (networking, auth, telemetry)

Proposed slots (PDT):
- Wed Aug 25, 10:00–11:15
- Thu Aug 26, 08:30–09:45

Ben (pre-sales eng) will cover runtime/topology details. I attached a draft agenda and a short runbook outline so you can flag anything to add.

If neither slot works, tell me a couple of windows that suit Alex/Priya and we'll adapt.

Thanks —
Soojin

Appreciate the agenda. Wed 10:00 is short notice for our infra team (we have a sprint demo at the same time). Thu 08:30 PDT would work for Priya, but I’m on travel and can only do 09:30–10:30 PDT. Are you able to do Thu 09:30–10:45? That still gives us a decent window.

Alex —

Thanks for the quick reply and the window. Thu 25 Aug 2027 09:30–10:45 PDT works for us (I’ll send the invite).

Ben — can you lead the throughput examples and prepare a 10–15 minute section on batching/quantization tradeoffs for sequences similar to what Alex described? If helpful, I attached an updated runbook outline and moved the telemetry checklist earlier in the agenda.

Priya/Alex — if you can drop traffic histograms and a short list of integration blockers into the shared Drive link before EOD Wed, we’ll tailor the prep.

I’ll issue the calendar invite with the Google Meet link and the doc link. Included below is a short pre-call checklist so we don’t run into firewall/KMS issues during the demo: 

Pre-call checklist:
- Confirm IP allowlist range for our transient test runner (if you want us to run a short smoke test)
- Confirm contact who can approve limited sample data access (if needed)
- Share one representative prompt/sequence length distribution

Thanks — looking forward to it.

—Soojin
